literal_meaning: নবাব সিরাজদ্দৌলা (বাংলার শেষ স্বাধীন নবাবের নাম)
figurative_meaning_en: Excessive aristocratic pomp; a person with unruly or disorderly character
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নবাব সিরাজদ্দৌলার মতো আচরণ করে, সবসময় অহংকারী হয়ে থাকে।
এই লোকটি নবাব সিরাজদ্দৌলা-সদৃশ, কোনো শৃঙ্খলা মানে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He behaves like Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah, always full of pomp and arrogance.
This man is like Nawab Siraj ud-Daulah, with no regard for discipline.
history: Refers to Siraj ud-Daulah (1733-1757), the last independent Nawab of Bengal, known for his youthful impulsiveness and defeat by the British in the Battle of Plassey in 1757, symbolizing excessive authority and lack of restraint.
note: The idiom draws from the proverb-like usage highlighting Siraj's reputed extravagant and rebellious traits in Bengali folklore.
